TC-11/S22.title: Real phone with a wrong date or another time zone
TC-11/S22.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Our addition (10-15 review): recorded only. (A) Phone one day behind finished a Nursing Home visit (scripted note and course line): the entry reads 'Visit 1 – Oct 15: …' (the real day) on the phone and on the desktop - the server-clock label of TFA-92589 works. (B) The app was sent to the background, the phone's clock jumped a day ahead (past its midnight), and the app came back: it ended the session and asked for sign-in (run 1 showed 'Your session has ended. Taking you to sign in…'; known B33); after signing in, a Hospital pre-round save wrote 'Oct 15: …', again the real day on both devices. (C) The phone a day ahead, data wiped, signed in through its form with a new code and reached the app (so the new sign-in itself works). (D) A phone at the real time in Pacific/Honolulu wrote the resident's entry as 'Visit 2 – Oct 14: …' (its local day; the desktop's day is Oct 15), so the resident now shows Visit 2 dated a day before Visit 1 on every device - the time-zone device is Q4.
